## Load in Libaries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(tidytext)
library(fastDummies)
```

## Reading in the Dataframe

```{r}
wine <- readRDS(gzcon(url("https://github.com/cd-public/D505/raw/master/dat/model.rds")))
```

## Tidy Text

```{r}
library(tidytext)
wine_desc <- wine %>%
  filter(province == "Oregon") %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, description) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words) %>%
  count(word) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

wine_desc
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

wine %>%
  distinct(province)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)

# Province list
selected_provinces <- c("Oregon", "New_York", "California", "Casablanca_Valley", "Burgundy", "Marlborough")

# Step 2: Tokenize and count words for selected provinces
word_counts <- wine %>%
  filter(province %in% selected_provinces) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, description) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words) %>%
  count(province, word)

# Step 3: Separate words for ____ (province)
newyork_words <- word_counts %>% filter(province == "New_York") %>% select(word, n)
other_words <- word_counts %>% filter(province != "New_York") %>% select(word) %>% distinct()

# Step 4: Find words unique to New York (fix comment)
unique_newyork <- newyork_words %>%
  anti_join(other_words, by = "word") %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

print(unique_newyork)

```

## Engineering Features

         chocolate = str_detect(description, "chocolate"),
         earth = str_detect(description, "earth"),
         oak = str_detect(description, "oak"),

         pepper_year = year * pepper,

         balance_year = year * balance,

         raspberry_year = year * raspberry,
         cranberry_year = year * cranberry,
         alert_year = year * alert,
         allergic_year = year * allergic,
         acids_year = year * acids,
         willamette_year = year * willamette,
         stiff_year = year * stiff,
         details_year = year * details,
         lick_year = year * lick,
         beaune_year = year * beaune,
         nuits_year = year * nuits,
         georges_year = year * georges,
         chambertin_year = year * chambertin,

## Building KNN Model

```{r}
set.seed(43)

split <- createDataPartition(wino$province, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train <- wino[split, ]
test <- wino[-split, ]
fit <- train(province ~ .,
             data = train, 
             method = "knn",
             metric = "Kappa",
             trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5))

confusionMatrix(predict(fit, test),factor(test$province))
```
